en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ya’qoub bin Yazid, from Muhammed bin Abi ‘Umayr, from Muhammed bin Hamran, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, that he said:

The one who says: «There is no god but Allah» sincerely, will enter Paradise, and his sincerity is that «There is no god but Allah» will constrain him from that which Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He, has forbidden.
